svg.text: ISO 9660 + Rock Ridge + Joliet, UDF 1.02 bridge
RS03 augmented image (dvdisaster Light): Reed-Solomon over the whole image,
filesystem included, sized to fill the medium (at least 20% redundancy).
Padding, header (H), CRC layer and ECC follow the filesystem; a reader that knows nothing of RS03 just sees the filesystem.
names checked for each image type
the folder itself is never changed
every disc so far, minus sealed

copy A's image to fill its gaps
mount, or 7-Zip: no tool of ours
Every disc stands alone: any one disc, on any computer, holds its files, the whole catalogue,
the source of its tools and the steps to repair it.
